claim_boundary: Engineering belief trace. It records decisions and falsification, not AGI capability or product superiority.

entries.belief: A full sandbox provider should be admitted by capability, not name or binary presence.
entries.change: Bubblewrap provider is optional and admitted only after executable probe; untrusted execution never silently downgrades.
entries.observation: This host has no bubblewrap; only partial user/network namespace capability exists.
entries.probe: Run an actual minimal namespace/mount probe and inspect provider receipt claims.
entries.rival: Finding bubblewrap on PATH is enough to claim safe execution.
entries.verifier: alpha10 sandbox tests + demo world summary

entries.belief: Path leases plus global revision checks are enough for useful multi-agent concurrency.
entries.change: Read-set invalidation notifications block owner commit until selective revalidation; only then may optimistic rebase proceed.
entries.observation: A disjoint path precondition can still coexist with stale cognition.
entries.probe: Agent A observes config.py and stages auth.py; Agent B commits config.py before A commits auth.py.
entries.rival: Agents can hold stale read assumptions even when their target path is disjoint.

entries.belief: Global hypothesis confidence can summarize a multi-agent team.
entries.change: Shared hypothesis remains common; agent_hypothesis_beliefs stores private stance/confidence/rationale.
entries.observation: Shared world object and agent belief state need separate namespaces.
entries.probe: Create one shared hypothesis and assign opposing/private stances to two agents.
entries.rival: Different agents may legitimately hold conflicting beliefs over the same shared hypothesis.

entries.belief: Repository guidance files should be injected automatically because they may help.
entries.change: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/CONTRIBUTING/Copilot instructions become scoped guidance metadata with explicit paged reads.
entries.observation: Unfiltered context is not reliably beneficial; Habitat can discover guidance without forcing it into solver history.
entries.probe: Research current context-retrieval findings and compare guidance presence with Habitat page-fault architecture.
entries.rival: Static guidance can pollute context and increase exploration cost.

entries.belief: Same-model A/B readiness can be inferred from using similar commands/prompts.
entries.change: A/B schema 3 exposes comparability; strong_evidence_ready requires all IDs present/unique and independent evaluator.
entries.observation: Comparability can be mechanically gated rather than narrated.
entries.probe: Run contract smoke with explicit identical IDs plus independent evaluator, then omit evaluator.
entries.rival: Without observed model/scaffold identity and independent evaluator the report is not controlled evidence.

entries.belief: Per-module process isolation is the safest default test matrix.
entries.change: Test matrix defaults to four empirically balanced process shards; module mode remains forensic.
entries.observation: Per-module default exceeded the runner budget; manually balanced four shards completed all tests.
entries.probe: Run module-isolated matrix across the suite.
entries.rival: Repeated provider startup makes isolation itself the dominant test cost.

entries.belief: More parallel test shards should reduce wall time.
entries.change: Release admission records sequential isolated shard results; parallel mode remains optional/host-sensitive.
entries.observation: The external runner timed out while four individually admitted shards passed sequentially.
entries.rival: Provider/browser/language-service contention can make parallelism host-sensitive.

entries.belief: Git temporal cognition can be implemented from formatted command output without a real-repo regression.
entries.change: Use tab separator contract supported by for-each-ref.
entries.observation: for-each-ref did not interpret the original separator as expected.
entries.probe: Run branch discovery on a real temporary repository.
entries.rival: Git subcommands have different format escape semantics.
